symptom.observed: 5555 /v1/responses frequently reports provider_response_sse_terminal_missing after a provider Responses SSE ends without response.completed
symptom.expected: response.completed is the only provider Responses success terminal; pre-client Relay failures re-enter typed Error01-05 reselection, while post-client Direct failures remain explicit stream failures

forbidden_edges: target resolution source error -> old provider terminal projection

hypotheses.cause: The upstream provider intermittently closes Responses SSE before response.completed
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: The failing sample reaches EOF with provider_response_sse_terminal_missing; replay later succeeds with response.completed, proving stochastic upstream behavior.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: The upstream incomplete stream cannot be prevented locally without fabricating business terminal semantics.
hypotheses.verification_action: Replay the exact request through installed 5555 and inspect provider/client SSE events.

hypotheses.cause: Error05 swallows target-resolution source errors and fabricates route/default exhaustion from an Err value
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: run_v3_relay_provider_failure_policy uses if let Ok(alternative), then later builds ProjectTerminal with zero remaining/default false.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: Only V3TargetInterpreter::select_available exhaustion is authoritative exhaustion evidence.
hypotheses.verification_action: Inject classifier/config target-resolution failure and assert it remains its own Error01 instead of projecting the prior provider failure.

hypotheses.cause: Recovery state stores only a bool and reselects the latest same-group lane instead of the exact failure key/generation
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Consumers use pending_provider_action_gate plus max_by_key(next_admission_at), so concurrent failures can redirect recovery to another key.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: Pinned continuations correctly require exact-provider lookup but do not solve exact failure-family generation ownership.
hypotheses.verification_action: Record a recovery ticket, add an unrelated/newer lane, and assert the ticket cannot consume or silently switch to it.

hypotheses.cause: Direct Stopless response hooks accept response.done before provider terminal validation
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: transform_direct_sse_stopless_control_frame accepts response.completed or response.done even though closeout later requires response.completed.
hypotheses.counter_evidence_or_gap: response.done is valid only on the client projection side after canonical completion.
hypotheses.verification_action: Feed response.done without response.completed and assert Stopless state is unchanged before explicit terminal-missing failure.
